1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application stands disposed of.

3. By way of the present petition, the petitioner seeks quashing of FIR bearing no. 541/2020,
registered at Police Station Hari Nagar, New Delhi for the commission of offence punishable under Sections 376/506 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 (hereafter 'IPC').
4.

sentences.text: The petitioner and respondent no. 2 have appeared before this Court in person.
They have been identified by their counsels and concerned Investigating Officer (IO) from Police Station Hari Nagar, New Delhi.

The present FIR arose out of the matrimonial dispute between the parties.

It is stated that the marriage between petitioner no. 3 and respondent no. 2 was solemnized on 10.02.2020 as per Shahrukh & Ors vs The State & Anr on 8 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/189143232/

sentences.text: Muslim rites and ceremonies at Delhi.
No child was born out of their wedlock.
After some time, due to some temperamental differences, both the parties started residing separately since 05.05.2020.
Thereafter, respondent no. 2 had filed a complaint before the concerned Police Station which culminated into the present FIR.

It is stated that with the intervention of elders and well wishers,
both the parties have amicably settled the present matter vide Settlement Deed dated 14.11.2024 and had obtained divorce as per their customs.

6. On a query made by this Court, respondent no.2 who has been identified by the concerned IO, has categorically stated that she has entered into compromise out of her own free will and without any pressure, coercion or threat.

It is also stated by respondent no. 2 that the entire dispute has been amicably settled between the parties and she has received the last and final amount of 1,00,000/-
vide Demand Draft No. 784944 drawn on State Bank of India, New Delhi.
Respondent no. 2 further states that she has no objection if the present FIR is quashed.

7. In view of the above fact that the parties have amicably resolved their differences of their own free will, without any coercion and no useful purpose will be served by continuing the proceedings,
rather the same would create further acrimony between them.
It would thus be in interest of justice to quash the abovementioned FIR and the proceedings pursuant thereto.
There is no legal impediment in quashing the FIR in question.
8. Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that after lodging of the present complaint, on the basis of which the This is a digitally signed order.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 09/07/2025 at 22:01:33 present FIR was registered, the parties were married and since they are living together, the FIR bearing No. 72/2021, registered at Police Station Patel Nagar, New Delhi for the commission of offence punishable under Sections 363/366/376 of IPC and all consequential proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
9.
In view of the above, the present petition stands disposed of.
10. The order be uploaded on the website forthwith.
DR. SWARANA KANTA SHARMA, J JULY 08, 2025/ns
